# iswar.me

> Technical writing by Iswar C. Mondal — SEO, AI search, Astro, and building on the open web.

Static Astro blog. All articles are plain HTML with zero client-side JavaScript, so every page is fully readable in the initial HTML response. No authentication, no paywall, no rate limits beyond host defaults.

## Content

- [Home](https://iswar.me/): latest articles
- [Blog archive](https://iswar.me/blog/): every published post
- [About](https://iswar.me/about/): author bio and contact
- [RSS feed](https://iswar.me/rss.xml): full article feed
- [Sitemap](https://iswar.me/sitemap-index.xml): all canonical URLs

## For AI agents

- [design.md](https://iswar.me/design.md): brand and design system as raw markdown (typography, colors, layout rules) for use when producing assets or subdomain apps for this site.

## Notes

- Canonical URLs use trailing slashes (e.g. `/blog/post-name/`).
- `/projects/*` URLs permanently redirect to `/blog/`.
